name: devotts
description: DevOtts marketplace for Claude Code plugins. Add this repo, then install init-it (register a session against an implementation). Shares the devotts namespace with plan-it, build-it, review-it, conclude-it and prompt-it.

plugins.name: init-it
plugins.description: Register this session against docs/implementations/<name>: status.json sessions[] entry (via build-it status-write), open ledger card, INDEX row. Deterministic, idempotent, no network.
